authorization_source: Direct Owner instruction in the controlling execution conversation to bind the exact provider/model, isolation, context, budgets, stop conditions, evidence destinations, and explicit execution authorization, without disclosing adjudicator-only ground truth.
evidentiary_limit: This artifact records the controlling conversational directive; it is not a digital signature or independent identity attestation.
ready_effect: Authorization alone does not make the run ready. Repository binding must merge with green CI and runtime preflight must pass.
void_if: target commit/tree or critical blob identity changes
budget, timeout, sampling, or stop conditions change
execution would exceed the stated claim ceiling
